title: A late Ack from the pre-reload document terminates the carrier
trigger: A delivery is in flight, the relay page reloads inside the scope; the old document's Ack IPC message arrives after LoadStarted had already moved the delivery back to pending
effect: heard() finds no matching in_flight and returns Err, so the carrier fails with Terminated and the proxy is dropped although nothing is wrong
fix: Tag acks with a document epoch (part of the Document enum) and ignore acks from an older epoch instead of failing.

title: ConferenceInviteResults keeps pending requests that can never settle if the call goes first
trigger: Add people to a new conference, then leave the conference before all invite answers arrive
effect: is_done never becomes true for a dropped request so invite_results lingers and its toast never shows
fix: Clear invite_results with the conference call, or settle pending as failed when the request is taken

title: check_in_flight has no request id and CanTransferOwnership is not swept, so a lost answer blocks every later check
trigger: Open the transfer dialog; the canTransferOwnership answer never arrives (connection drop while the request stays registered). Close and reopen the dialog: check_can_transfer_ownership returns early on check_in_flight.
effect: The transfer dialog keeps its checking state; Transfer never becomes available until the account session restarts.
fix: Store `Option<RequestId>` and let a new dialog open replace it; or make the request sweepable.

title: A late isProfileAudio answer overwrites a local save or remove made in the meantime
trigger: Open a song's Save to menu (isProfileAudio sent), tap Save to Profile before the answer; local_save_profile_audio sets the id true, then the check answers 404 and apply_profile_music_error sets it false.
effect: The menu offers Profile again for a track that is saved (or shows Remove for a track just removed) until the next check.
fix: Make the per-song state `Unknown | Asking(RequestId) | Known(bool)` and drop an answer when a local change replaced Asking.

title: Row-progress grading uses only the main window's rows, so auto-download progress in a chat window is always coalesced
trigger: Open a chat in its own window while the main window shows another chat; photos auto-download in the chat window. file_need compares against RowsOnScreen (reported by the main window only) and falls to RedrawNeed::Later.
effect: Download progress and the completing row update in batches instead of live in the chat window (cosmetic).
fix: Report rows per window view (WindowViews) and test the window that draws the chat, as interaction_need does for the chat-window case.

title: is_sweepable leaves the later-page and tab searches out, so a lost answer keeps their in-flight state
trigger: Open global search, Channels tab or Posts tab, or press Load more; the answer is lost.
effect: Leg stays Pending (panel says Searching), tabs.loading_more or recommended_loading stays true until a new query; Load more is refused.
fix: Give the in-flight state a deadline in one Fetch value or add these purposes to the sweep list.

title: A stale public-forwards page is appended to a freshly reopened post's statistics
trigger: Open Message Statistics for post A, load more public forwards, and while page 2 is in flight open post B's statistics and then post A's again.
effect: begin_message gives A a fresh empty state, and the in-flight page-2 answer (matched by chat and message only) is appended to it: page 2's forwards show without page 1, next_offset continues past them, and message_forwards_loaded now reports loaded so page 1 is never asked.
fix: Record the forwards request id (or the offset it asked) in the list and accept only the answer to it; dropping the state for another post should also forget its request.

title: Fast buttons mode invalidates only the main window's history rows
trigger: Turn on fast buttons (the numberbuttons code) or toggle it in Experimental settings while a chat window is open with bot buttons.
effect: set_experimental_option clears self.history.rows_key, the main window's slot only; a chat window keeps its cached rows without (or with) the digits until its next history refresh.
fix: Invalidate the rows of every WindowSlot (or key the row cache by the fast-buttons mode).

title: The Experimental settings page reads the system clipboard on every render
trigger: Settings > Advanced > Experimental settings, leave it open while chats update.
effect: experimental_settings_page calls cx.read_from_clipboard() each time the page renders to decide whether Import shows. On X11/Wayland a clipboard read is a round trip to the selection owner, done on the UI thread on every QuillApp notify while the page is open; the Import button also does not appear when the clipboard changes until something else redraws.
fix: Read the clipboard once when the page opens (and on window focus), keeping the result in the page's state.

title: Autoscroll loop is not owned by the mode, so a stop then a quick new press runs two loops
trigger: Middle-click to start autoscroll, click to stop, and middle-click again within one 15 ms tick.
effect: The first spawn_scoped_in loop is still awaiting its timer. active is Some again (new anchor), so the old loop's autoscroll_plan returns a step and it keeps scrolling next to the new loop: double speed until the mode stops. The task is detached and not stored with Active.
fix: Hold the Task inside Active (dropped when active becomes None), or give Active a press token that the loop compares on each plan.

title: Import-contacts read token `pick` restarts at 0 with every new box, so a read from a closed box can land in the next one
trigger: Open Import contacts, choose a large .vcf (read starts, pick=1), close the box, reopen it and choose another file (pick=1 again) before the first read ends
effect: The first file's contacts replace the 'Reading...' state of the second choice and Import is enabled for the wrong file until the second read lands; the picker answer in choose_vcard_file is also applied to whichever box is open when it returns
fix: Make the token process-wide (a counter on the app, or a ScreenEpoch-style id kept outside the dialog) or key the read by a box id that is never reused.

title: Device-link result that lands after leaving the Devices page shows as a stale notice on the next visit
trigger: Settings > Devices > Link device (scan or paste a tg://login link) > Link device; leave the Devices page before Telegram answers; open Devices again later.
effect: poll_device_qr clears the UI and returns while the page is not Devices without taking session.settings.device_login_result; the next visit shows 'Device linked' / 'couldn't be linked' for the old attempt.
fix: Drop or consume device_login_result when the flow is cleared (clear_device_qr), or key it by the ConfirmDeviceLogin request id held in the UI's link stage.

title: 'Waiting for Telegram to link the device' notice has no exit if the answer is consumed off the Devices page
trigger: Confirm a scanned device, then leave Settings > Devices before the answer lands, return later
effect: poll_device_qr returns early (clear_device_qr) while the page is not Devices, leaving device_login_result in the session; on return the stale Linked/Failed result shows as a fresh notice, and if the answer never lands the Waiting notice sticks until the page is left
fix: Make the Waiting stage of the DeviceLink enum leave on the answer regardless of page, and clear a stale result on leave_devices.

title: Downloads panel open flag lives in the Session and nothing closes it on an account switch
trigger: Open the Downloads panel in account A, switch to account B, switch back to A.
effect: A's Downloads panel is open again on switch back (and is drawn from the retired Session's flag), unlike OnScreen panels that start closed.
fix: Hold the panel flag in an OnScreen feature struct (or add a Farewell closer) instead of the Session.

title: Archive build error note is shown in whatever chat is open, and the 'Preparing the archive' note is never settled when the person moved on
trigger: Drop a large folder on the 'Send as archive' zone in chat A, switch to chat B (same account) before zipping ends and let the build fail (too large, unreadable file), or let it succeed.
effect: archive_ready checks send_slot() only in the Ok arm; the Err arm sets an error StatusNote for the current chat B, and the Ok-but-moved-on early return leaves the earlier 'Preparing the archive' note unreplaced until it times out. No in-flight marker exists, so a second drop starts a second zip.
fix: Make the archive job a stage value keyed by SendSlot (Building(slot) -> Ready/Failed) owned by the slot's composer state, and apply both arms only when the key still matches.

title: A finished archive for another chat is dropped silently and leaves the 'Preparing the archive' note
trigger: Drop a folder on the 'one archive' zone, then open another chat before zipping ends.
effect: archive_ready returns when send_slot() differs and sets no note, so the 'Preparing the archive...' note stays until something else replaces it and the user never learns the archive was discarded.
fix: Carry the preparing note as a stage tied to the slot and clear or replace it in every arm of archive_ready.

title: Quit-while-exporting exit callback is lost if the screen is replaced while the Stop and quit alert is open
trigger: Quit with an export running (alert opens, exit stored in dialogs.export_stop), an account switch/removal replaces OnScreen, press Stop
effect: Exports are cancelled but the app does not quit; the alert closes and the Quit press is swallowed
fix: Keep the pending exit on the app (QuillApp), not in the per-account OnScreen; the alert is window-level and app-wide.

title: Fact check text is dropped when the save request cannot be sent
trigger: Edit a fact check, press Save while the driver refuses the request
effect: Dialog closes with an error note; the typed text is gone and cannot be retried
fix: Take the dialog only on Ok; on Err keep it open with the error.

title: A replayed intro clip keeps playing with sound under the passcode lock
trigger: Settings > Advanced > replay onboarding, then lock Quill (passcode hotkey) while the clip plays.
effect: The lock draws only the lock screen, so first_run_view/first_run_curtain (which run settle, the volume fade and the pause) stop running, and close_for_lock does not touch app.first_run: the clip's audio plays on to its end behind the lock.
fix: close_for_lock pauses or finishes FirstRun (skip_intro + pause the player), or the player is paused by the lock gate.

title: Debounced window-state save flag sticks when the window is gone before the 600 ms timer fires
trigger: Main window is replaced after a lost GPU (forget_native_window) or closed within 600 ms of a move/resize; the spawn_in task's update_in returns Err and never clears the flag
effect: schedule_window_state_save returns early forever after: geometry is staged but only written to disk on quit, so a crash loses the window position
fix: Replace the bool with a SaveTimer enum (Idle | Scheduled(Task)) holding the task, so dropping the task or window returns it to Idle

title: Storage limit sliders apply only on Release
trigger: Drag a storage slider and release outside the control or lose the pointer.
effect: If Release is not delivered the label shows the new value but the limit was never applied.
fix: Apply on blur or dialog close too.

title: Live location 'expires in' line is refreshed only for the main window's open chat
trigger: Open a chat with a running live location in its own chat window while another chat is open in the main window.
effect: ensure_live_location_tick is keyed on session.open_chat and only notifies when the main window is active, so the chat window's countdown does not tick.
fix: Run the tick per window slot (WindowSlot) keyed by the chat shown there.

title: Opening the marketplace from another chat while a purchase is loading keeps the first chat
trigger: Start loading a gift from chat A's Send Gift box, close the box, open Buy by name from chat B before it finishes.
effect: busy skips the reset, so marketplace_chat stays A and the gift buys for A; B's request is silently dropped (recipient name shown is A's).
fix: Key the gift by ChatId and compare it with the asking chat before reusing it.

title: Selection check animations are keyed by bare message id
trigger: In one window select messages in chat A (selection mode on), switch to chat B, whose first message has the same id (TDLib private and basic-group ids start at the same value in every chat) while the fade-out is still running.
effect: SelectionFx::checks (HashMap<i64, CheckAnim>) is kept until the mode glide settles, so for ~150 ms B's row with the same id draws A's check state.
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) or clear on chat change (sync_chat_ui).
